one_month_reasoning: The window (to 2026-11-01) very likely contains Q3 2026 earnings (Rambus reported Q1 on Apr 27 and Q2 on Jul 27, so late October is the expected date). Q3 guidance is revenue $210-216M, product $110-116M, non-GAAP EPS $0.75-0.82, which already embeds +11-17% sequential product growth. The stock has had large earnings reactions in 2026 (roughly -16% after Q4 guidance in Feb and ~-21% to -23% after Q1 in April, then a positive reaction to the Q2 beat), so the distribution should be wide. The key swing factor is the Q4 product guide and any commentary on 2027 RDIMM unit risk from DRAM supply tightness, versus MRDIMM/companion-chip ramps. The ~$100M ASR started Aug 4 is mild support. I have no edge on the direction of the print, so I use a near-symmetric lognormal centered at ~$112.5 (tiny positive drift for the ASR and the beat-and-raise record in Q2) with a 20% one-month sigma, close to the 80%/3.5 rule with the earnings event inside the window.

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (NTM EPS at Oct-2027 of ~$3.90 x 30x = $117) and EV/FCF yield (2027E FCF $360M at a 3% yield plus ~$725M net cash = ~$118/share); weights 60/40 give ~$117.

inputs_detail.derivation: Q3'26 guide annualizes to ~$3.15; add ~15% product growth (MRDIMM ramp material in 2027 per management, companion chips to mid-teens % of product revenue) partly offset by flat royalties (~$290M run-rate: Q4'25 $71.6M, Q1'26 $69.6M, Q2'26 $84.2M, Q3 guide $69-75M) and the DRAM-supply risk to RDIMM unit growth flagged by Baird; buyback trims share count ~1%.
Q4'27-Q3'28 blend of 2027E $3.55 and 2028E ~$4.10 (continued ~15% EPS growth from DDR5/MRDIMM content gains, roughly the 2025-26 product growth rate of 15-22%).

Today $111.97 / 2026E $3.03 = ~37x trailing-forward and ~32x 2027E; I assume modest de-rating to 30x on NTM as growth decelerates and DRAM-supply/DOJ overhangs persist; analyst targets ($114-$165, consensus ~$149 in July) bracket this.

bear.story: DRAM capacity diverted to HBM caps server RDIMM unit growth in 2027 (Baird's thesis; module-maker DRAM supply sharply down), MRDIMM ramp slips with CPU platforms, royalties stay flat and the DOJ antitrust grand-jury matter produces a fine or business-practice change; 2027 EPS ~$3.1 at ~23x.

base.story: Product revenue grows mid-teens in 2027 on RCD share plus PMIC/SPD/companion chips and early MRDIMM; royalties ~flat; buybacks continue; stock trades ~30x NTM EPS of ~$3.9-4.0.

bull.story: AI inference/agentic CPU demand drives a strong 2027 server cycle; MRDIMM ($600-700M SAM) and SOCAMM2/LPDDR5X server modules ramp; companion chips reach mid-teens % of product revenue; EPS run-rate >$4.3 and multiple back to ~40x, retesting the $174 high.

thesis_break_reason: Below the $77.89 52-week low and ~35% under today, a sustained trade near $72 would imply the market sees EPS declining rather than growing (about 23x on a ~$3.1 run-rate): e.g. RDIMM unit contraction from DRAM supply diversion to HBM, share loss in DDR5 RCD to Montage/Renesas, a material DOJ antitrust outcome, or loss of a top customer (Customer A was 22-25% of revenue, Customer B 15-16%).

reasoning: Primary-document work: Q2'26 8-K release shows record revenue $207.4M (+20% y/y), product $99.2M (+22%), non-GAAP EPS $0.77, and a Q3 guide of $210-216M revenue with product $110-116M (+11-17% q/q) and EPS $0.75-0.82, so 2H26 is accelerating after a weak Q1 ($180.2M, EPS $0.63) that triggered a ~21% drop and a Baird downgrade on DRAM supply risk for 2027. The 10-Q adds what recaps skip: a DOJ Antitrust Division criminal grand-jury subpoena since Q1'26, Customer A at 25% of H1 revenue, a $30.7M H1 inventory build, cash of $824.9M and no debt; an Aug 4 8-K shows a $100M ASR (~$100/share implied initial delivery) and a Sep 4 8-K a CAO change (benign). I estimate 2026 non-GAAP EPS ~$3.03 and 2027 ~$3.55; at $111.97 the stock is ~32x 2027E. Fair value blends 30x NTM EPS ($117) and a 3% FCF yield ($118) = ~$117, i.e. close to spot, so the expected return is modest and the distribution is dominated by volatility. I model the 12-month distribution as a mixture of bear ($72, 25%), base ($120, 50%) and bull ($172, 25%) lognormals (sigmas 25-35%), giving a median ~$118, mean ~$121 and an effective spread consistent with a stock that has 80% realized vol but whose fundamentals are steadier (I shade below the realized vol because much of it came from three earnings gaps). Research limits: earnings-call transcripts (GuruFocus, Nasdaq, StatementDog) were blocked or empty, so call commentary (MRDIMM SAM ~$600-700M, companion chips low-teens to mid-teens % of product) comes from search snippets/Quartr summary; Alpha Vantage and Twelve Data estimate endpoints were rate-limited or paywalled, so consensus 2027 EPS is not directly cited.
